== Biography ==
Lois was the daughter of [[Glasgow-589|Moses Glasgow]].

The family account names her mother as [[Pierce-14470|Mary J. Pierce]] and places her with [[Glasgow-2356|Robert Finley]] and an infant John Cameron among the children of Moses and Mary. Mary died on 14 March 1846; Moses married [[Thompson-63146|Martha Thompson]] in 1848, making Martha the children’s stepmother. The same account reports that Lois died of consumption in June 1870.<ref name="GlasgowFamilyHistory">[https://www.wikitree.com/photo.php/0/0a/Glasgow-590.pdf History of the Glasgow Family], attributed to William Melanchthon Glasgow, undated typescript, p. 5.</ref>
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-589]] is assessed at 96% (proved). Moses's retained family-history account explicitly lists Lois Ladd among his children by Mary Pierce. Lois also appears in Moses's 1850 and 1860 households, identifying the named father strongly despite the censuses lacking relationship columns.

Selected Glasgow-589 fatherhood of Glasgow-2357; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the full family-history passage with both census groups.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/photo/pdf/Glasgow-590 Family history document written by William Melanchthon Glasgow [https://www.wikitree.com/photo/pdf/Glasgow-590]]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.

=== Maternal and vital review, 26 October 2026 ===

The original family-history page 5 records [[Glasgow-589|Moses]] and [[Pierce-14470|Mary Pierce]] married 5 November 1839, with three children: Lois Ladd, [[Glasgow-2356|Robert Finley]], and an infant John Cameron. It records Mary’s death on 14 March 1846 and Moses’s marriage to [[Thompson-63146|Martha Thompson]] in 1848. The same account says Lois died of consumption in June 1870. This supplies a retrospective month-and-year death report; the exact day, place, and original death record remain unverified.

Mary J. Pierce is assessed at '''93% confident, qualified to the retrospective family-account scope''', as Lois’s biological mother. Martha Thompson is '''strongly supported as stepmother''' to the children of Moses’s first marriage; no biological percentage is assigned to Martha. This reviews the existing Mary relationship; the separate father assessment remains 96%.

Her birth is estimated to 1842. Mary’s source description as being in her “26th year” is compatible with a birth before 1821 and is not treated as a contradiction. The family-history source is undated, retrospective, attributed to William Melanchthon Glasgow, and not an original birth or death certificate.
